metadata.description: One plugin for the oh-my-pi token economy: prefix-cache accounting for every provider whose models report cached input tokens (DeepSeek, OpenCode Go, Google Gemini, LithosAI, Anthropic, OpenAI), a cache-safe tool-result reducer, a governor that applies the core omp settings which keep the prefix byte-stable and cheap (runtime overrides, revertible), and the account behind the model — balance, quota windows with burn rate, and this session's USD cost.

plugins.name: omp-token-mega
plugins.description: Merged token plugin for oh-my-pi. Accounts the prefix cache on every provider whose models report cached input tokens — DeepSeek, OpenCode Go, Google Gemini, LithosAI, Anthropic, OpenAI — with hit rate, miss attribution, tool-catalogue drift and subagent aggregation; shrinks a tool result before it is ever sent, never after; polls the account behind the model (DeepSeek's balance, OpenCode Go's 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota windows with a burn rate) and the session's USD cost; and applies the core settings a model wants changed — append-only context, thinking replay, retry, subagent budget — as session overrides with one-command revert.
